{{Top}}
{{Quote|I was thinking that if you're going to have to put up with enforced downtime, there are worse ways to do it than with a good brandy and your best girl.|[[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]] to [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|his wife]]|<ref name="Legacy of the Force: Fury">''[[Legacy of the Force: Fury]]''</ref>}}
'''Brandy''' was an [[Alcohol/Legends|alcoholic]] beverage. It was classified as a type of [[Liquor/Legends|liquor]].<ref name="Legacy of the Force: Fury" /> There were many brandies available throughout [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]]. When consumed, it would warm the drinker from within.<ref name="X-Wing: Solo Command">''[[X-Wing: Solo Command]]''</ref> It had a sweet taste.<ref name="The Old Republic: Annihilation">''[[The Old Republic: Annihilation]]'', Chapter 18</ref>

The consumption of quality brandy was often associated with snobbery.<ref name="Galaxy Guide 9: Fragments from the Rim">''[[Galaxy Guide 9: Fragments from the Rim]]''</ref>
